items.evidence: Runner and dylibs were hashed, but the final launcher, disks, Bun, bundle metadata, notarized archive, and accepted record subjects are incomplete.
Commit, patches, Cargo.lock, firmware archive, and kernel.c are pinned; Debian sysroot packages and complete libkrunfw/kernel source materials are not.
PATCH_REVIEW.md records upstreamability and launcher findings that remain open.
Two default clean builds diverged; two path-remapped, deployment-target-14 builds matched for both dylibs. The retained production candidate build does not yet enforce that control.
A target/feature-resolved CycloneDX input exists, but toolchain, sysroot, guest launcher, disks, Bun, and complete license-file review are not release-complete.
The in-toto/SLSA-shaped file is an unsigned incomplete input from an untrusted local builder.
Current rebuild used ad-hoc identities because no valid signing identity was available.
No notary submission, ticket/staple, Gatekeeper acceptance, or clean-machine test was performed in this track.
Upstream declares Apple Silicon/macOS 14+, and controlled dylibs declared minOS 14.0, but the rebuilt runner/firmware declared 26.0 and no exact bundle ran on macOS 14.
Obligations are inventoried, but no complete corresponding-source/license publication bundle was created or reviewed by counsel.
OPERATIONS.md defines ownership and workflows; implementations, credentials, exercises, and readback evidence do not exist.
The remaining Gate C malicious-guest, output, disk, installed recovery, update, and full shared corpus are outside or incomplete for this track.
